paragraphs: We are not just a social media agency. We are a growth partner.
360 Vision is a full-stack creative and marketing agency built by strategists, designers, developers, and analysts -- all focused on one thing: helping brands grow with precision and impact.
From content creation to paid media, 3D production to CRM integration, we do not just offer services -- we build systems that convert attention into results.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy – 360 Vision
Privacy.intro: 360 Vision is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we handle it when you use our website or services.

bullets: Send us a message via social media, WhatsApp, Messenger, etc.
secondaryBullets: Any message or files you send us

sections.body: When you visit our website, we may collect:

sections.title: 1.3 Information from Third-Party Platforms
sections.body: If you interact with our ads or forms on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Google, WhatsApp, or other platforms, we may receive basic info you provide through those services.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
bullets: Respond to your inquiries and messages
Improve website performance and user experience
Send relevant updates, offers, or newsletters (only if you opt in)

sections.body: We use cookies and similar tools to:

sections.title: 4. Sharing of Information
sections.body: We only share your data with:
bullets: Service providers (hosting, analytics, CRM tools, etc.)
Advertising platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok) only for campaign performance
Team members working on your project
sections.note: We do not share or sell your information to unrelated third parties.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. However, no online system is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute protection.

sections.body: We keep your information only as long as necessary for:

sections.title: 7. Third-Party Websites
sections.body: Our website may link to external websites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are not directed to individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Any changes will be posted on this page with a new "Last updated" date.

sections.title: 11. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to request access or deletion of your data, you can contact us.
